text: Follow-up (after 102.001-T lands): update the upstream spike/SKILL.md.tmpl in the external autoharness repo so regeneration preserves the in-repo docline findings-artifact fix (Principle IV, no out-of-tree writes). Refs: 102.001-T, 102-F, docs/exec-plans/2026-07-13-spike-findings-docline-reconciliation-plan.md.

Upstream autoharness PASS-only governance handoff: update external templates/agents/stage.agent.md.tmpl, templates/skills/plan-review/SKILL.md.tmpl, templates/skills/impl-plan/SKILL.md.tmpl, and templates/skills/harvest/SKILL.md.tmpl. Preserve one unique final exact-digest formal review record with complete attributed persona evidence; PASS-only Stage and direct-harvest admission; FAIL/ADVISORY/missing/stale/malformed zero-mutation behavior; stateless one-operation plan-apply routing; workspace/symlink containment; legacy bypass rejection; and explicit Constitution Check output. Principle IV: all four templates are outside C:\Source\GitHub\backlogit, must not be written here, and remain outside 094-S/095-S. Closure requires external landing, regeneration of all four .github targets, and parity tests for every listed PASS-only contract. Machine-managed waivers are deferred and not part of this handoff.

Add a supported, atomic shipment hold/requeue lifecycle for staged-but-unapproved work: queued -> blocked and blocked -> queued, with core and CLI tests ensuring requeue restores normal ClaimShipment item activation. Generic artifact updates currently permit shipment status blocked even though shipment lifecycle/ClaimShipment cannot resume it; shipments 094-S and 095-S must remain fail-closed until this prerequisite lands or an explicit operator-approved replacement-shipment procedure is used. Keep this Go/CLI concern width-isolated from planning-governance template work.

Extend optional size estimation to feature and shipment artifacts. Define level-specific size semantics for feature versus shipment; add size_source and size_ruleset_version metadata plus estimate-history behavior; expose derived composition/rollups without persisting derived values as though they were human-authored estimates.

Future authenticated plan-gate waiver support, deferred/YAGNI after PASS-only v1: trust only a live non-dismissed GitHub approval by a maintainer with repository permission, bound to repository, plan path/digest, scope, intended disposition, and expiry. Prefer one process owning any full authorized-to-reserved-to-consumed manifest. Do not harvest into 094-S.
